instructions: Canvases are design boards people and agents make together. Read a canvas (get_canvas, read_file), change its files and publish them with the version you read; a refused publish means someone published first: read again and merge. Comments are how people ask for changes: answer them with reply_comment and resolve them when done.

tools.name: list_canvases
tools.description: List the workplace's canvases: their IDs, titles, owners, current versions and boards.

query.description: Only canvases whose title contains this

tools.name: create_canvas
tools.description: Create a canvas: an index (canvas.json) with no boards, version 1. Add boards with publish.

tools.name: get_canvas
tools.description: A canvas's index (canvas.json, parsed), its files with their sizes, and its current version. Read this before publishing: publish needs the version you read.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read one file (path) or several (paths) of a canvas, at its current version or an older one. Text files come back as text, others as base64.

path.description: A file's path, as get_canvas lists it (canvas.json, Main.dc.html)

paths.description: Several paths in place of path

version.description: An older version to read; omit for the current one

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publish changes to a canvas as its next version. files maps a path to its new text, to {"base64": ...} for binary content, or to null to remove it; files not sent keep their content. base_version is the version your changes were made on (from get_canvas or read_file): if the canvas has moved on, the publish is refused, and you read the newer version, merge your change onto it and publish again. The index (canvas.json) must hold after the change: "v": 3, every board in "boards" (keyed by its file name, with numeric x, y, w, h) is a file, "order" lists every board once, and "createdOnFiles" stays as it is. A board is a <Name>.dc.html page: ./support.js, a <helmet> with its head content, an <x-dc> body whose {{values}}, <sc-if value> and <sc-for list as> come from the <script type="text/x-dc"> component (class Component extends DCLogic, renderVals()).

files.description: path -> new content (text, {base64}, or null to remove)

base_version.description: The version your changes were made on

label.description: A few words for the version history

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: A canvas's versions, oldest first: who published each, when, its label and the files it changed.

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Publish an older version's files as the canvas's next version.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: The comments on a canvas, as threads: each pinned to a board (and a point on it) or to the canvas.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Comment on a canvas, or on one of its boards at a point (x, y in the board's pixels).

tools.name: resolve_comment
tools.description: Resolve a comment's thread, or reopen it.
